headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu / Times of India
bullets_en: Delimitation ‘threat to democracy’, BJP wants take power into their own hands forever.
SC tells petitioner to approach High Court over election age representation.
Palaniswami calls TVK Kallakurichi MLA’s arrest a victory for AIADMK’s sustained agitations.
7 students killed in Afghanistan school blast; at least 99 hurt.
Job mela at Nampally on December 2, freshers and experienced candidates can attend.
bullets_ur: Hadd bandi jamhooriyat ke liye khatra hai, BJP hamesha ke liye iqtidaar apne haath mein lena chahti hai.
SC ne darkhwast guzaar se intekhabi umar ki numaindagi par High Court se ruju karne ko kaha.
Palaniswami ne TVK ke Kallakurichi MLA ki giraftari ko AIADMK ki musalsal tehreek ki jeet qarar diya.
Afghanistan ke school blast mein 7 talba halak, kam az kam 99 zakhmi.
Nampally mein 2 December ko job mela, freshers aur tajruba kar candidates shirakat kar sakte hain.
